description: List the owner’s polaris_learned_facts with filters and pagination (default 25, max 100). Filter by state (current/stale/disputed), provenance, category, unconfirmed_only, older_than_days, or query. Never dumps thousands. ($0.10; API key required)

older_than_days.description: Only rows whose learned_at is older than this many days.

provenance.description: How the fact was learned: stated, observed, inferred or imported, e.g. stated.

unconfirmed_only.description: Only rows that are not confirmed current.

name: list_learned_facts
title: List Learned Facts
